data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for scanning and transmitting as an iBeacon on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to scan, range, monitor, and transmit iBeacons on Android and iOS devices. It provides reactive stream APIs for ranging and monitoring beacon regions.
use_when: You need proximity-based indoor positioning using iBeacons.
Your app needs to transmit as an iBeacon.
You need to monitor and range beacon regions on iOS and Android.
avoid_when: You only need general Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) peripheral/central communication without iBeacon specifics.
You are developing for platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports both scanning/ranging and broadcasting as a beacon.
Reactive stream APIs for easy event listening.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of location and bluetooth permissions for Android and iOS.
Bluetooth on iOS simulator is disabled, requiring physical devices for testing.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding location and bluetooth permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and testing on physical devices.
